notes: Industrial unmanaged Gigabit PoE+ switch, IP-30 rugged housing, DIN-rail/wall mount by default (rackUnits omitted; an optional DIN-RACK-2U adapter can rack-mount it but it is not natively a rack unit). All 8 LAN ports are 10/100/1000Base-T(X) PoE+ (802.3at) Power Sourcing Equipment ports, up to 30W/port, 240W total PoE budget. Power input is dual redundant wide-range 9-55VDC on a 6-pin terminal block (screw/euroblock style); exact pin numbering not published by manufacturer, so mapped to closest connector id euroblock-dc. A 24VDC/1A dry-contact relay alarm output shares the same terminal-block connector family, mapped to generic euroblock (it is a signal contact, not a DC power delivery pin). No SFP ports and no console/management port confirmed absent (fully unmanaged switch) across two separate fetches of the manufacturer page. Exact on-device silkscreen labels for LAN ports (e.g. "P1" vs "LAN1") could not be confirmed from the fetched content, so "LAN 1".."LAN 8" is a reasonable approximation.
